# Button

A light touch, an instant response. Triggers actions and state changes.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="button" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | 'primary' \| 'outline' \| 'ghost' | 'primary' | Visual emphasis |
| `disabled` | boolean | false | Blocks interaction |
| `loading` | boolean | false | Shows work in progress and blocks repeated actions |
| `type` | 'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset' | 'button' | Native button type |

### Slots

- default: button text

## Keyboard and usage notes

Tab to focus; Enter or Space to activate. Loading and disabled buttons ignore input.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmButton } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yunyoujun.cn/r/button.json
```
